reviewNotes: All 48 diagrams and captions re-reviewed, including native40/42/44/45. Complete thirteen-piece later root after Kh8 at 109 seconds supports Re8+/Rxe8, then the essential Nf7+/Kg8/Nh6+ reroute. Native diagrams distinguish Nd8 before the rook offer from Nh6 before the queen offer. Both legal king replies are proved: source Kh8/Qg8+/Rxg8/Nf7 mate and independent Kf8/Qf7 mate. Earlier first rook offer and queen/king alternatives remain unverified.
